entries.subject: DAMIT 5856: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-5856.txt. Model 5856, version 2019-10-23, pole (301°, -10°), period 4.6224 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 21.82 ±1.4 km. mean radiometric diameter from IRAS flux-based albedo and H

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 5857: pole (125°, -15°), 4.62239 h, version 2019-10-23. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.
